targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND received_at >= date_trunc('day', now());
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND received_at > now() - interval '7 days';
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND received_at > now() - interval '30 days';

SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int > 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(*),0))::numeric(5,1) AS value FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND received_at > now() - interval '30 days';

SELECT avg((payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int)::numeric(10,1) AS value FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown' IS NOT NULL AND received_at > now() - interval '30 days';

SELECT count(DISTINCT payload->'scenario'->>'user_email') AS value FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' IS NOT NULL AND received_at > now() - interval '7 days';

panels.title: AMA reliability (7д)
panels.description: ama_success_count / ama_requests_count — % успешных вызовов к AMA-провайдеру.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (sum((payload->'scenario'->>'ama_success_count')::int) * 100.0 / NULLIF(sum((payload->'scenario'->>'ama_requests_count')::int), 0))::numeric(5,1) AS value FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario' ? 'ama_requests_count' AND received_at > now() - interval '7 days';

SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->'scenario'->>'compliance_flag')::boolean = true) * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(*),0))::numeric(5,1) AS value FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND received_at > now() - interval '7 days';

SELECT date_trunc('day', received_at) AS time, count(*)::float AS "searches" FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT date_trunc('day', received_at) AS time, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int > 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(*),0))::numeric(5,1) AS "conversion" FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT date_trunc('day', received_at) AS time, count(DISTINCT payload->'scenario'->>'user_email')::float AS "users" FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT date_trunc('day', received_at) AS time, (percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total')::int) / 1000.0)::numeric(10,1) AS "p50", (percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total')::int) / 1000.0)::numeric(10,1) AS "p95" FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' AS email, count(*)::int AS searches FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15;

SELECT (payload->'scenario'->>'origin') || ' → ' || (payload->'scenario'->>'destination') AS route, count(*)::int AS searches FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'origin' IS NOT NULL AND payload->'scenario'->>'destination' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15;

SELECT payload->'scenario'->>'origin' AS origin, count(*)::int AS searches FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'origin' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15;

panels.title: Funnel: started → completed → with tickets
panels.description: Сколько поисков юзер начал, сколько дошло до завершения, сколько получили хотя бы один билет (за выбранный период).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.started' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)) AS "1. Started", (SELECT count(*)::int FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)) AS "2. Completed", (SELECT count(*)::int FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int > 0 AND $__timeFilter(received_at)) AS "3. With tickets (≥1)";

panels.title: Распределение по числу билетов
panels.description: Сколько поисков попало в каждый bucket по tickets_shown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket, count(*)::int AS searches FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int = 0 THEN '0' WHEN (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN '1-5' WHEN (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10' WHEN (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11-20' ELSE '21+' END AS bucket, CASE WHEN (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int = 0 THEN 1 WHEN (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 2 WHEN (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN 3 WHEN (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS sort_idx FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at)) t GROUP BY bucket, sort_idx ORDER BY sort_idx;

panels.title: Early-return reasons
panels.description: Причины раннего выхода из поиска (compliance / неизвестная страна / возраст и т.п.). NULL = выход не было.

targets.rawSql: SELECT payload->'scenario'->>'early_return_reason' AS reason, count(*)::int AS searches FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'early_return_reason' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' AS "Email", count(*) AS "Поисков", max(received_at) AS "Последний поиск", avg((payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int)::numeric(10,1) AS "Avg билетов", ROUND((count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int > 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(*),0))::numeric, 1) AS "Конверсия %" FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT received_at AS "Время", payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' AS "Email", data AS "Запрос", payload->'scenario'->>'origin' || ' → ' || payload->'scenario'->>'destination' AS "Маршрут", (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int AS "Билетов", ((payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total')::int / 1000.0)::numeric(10,1) AS "Sec", payload->'scenario'->>'aviasales_url' AS "Aviasales URL", payload->'scenario'->>'onetwotrip_url' AS "OneTwoTrip URL" FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT received_at AS "Время", payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' AS "Email", data AS "Запрос", payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' AS "Тип ошибки", LEFT(payload->'scenario'->>'error_message', 300) AS "Сообщение" FROM events WHERE service='AMA_avia_project' AND type='scenario.failed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 50;
